name: Mean platelet volume
rangeNote: MPV depends on the analyser, the tube and how long the sample waited, so the app uses only your lab's own range. Results from different labs are hard to compare.
summary: MPV is the average size of your platelets, the cell fragments that help blood clot. It is mostly read together with the platelet count. On its own it is not used to diagnose any illness.

high.meaning: Larger platelets are often younger ones. MPV tends to rise when the platelet count is low and the bone marrow makes new platelets quickly. A slightly high value on its own usually means little.
commonCauses: Low platelet count with fast platelet turnover, for example from immune causes
A sample that waited a long time before testing

low.meaning: Smaller platelets on their own usually mean little. A low MPV is mainly of interest together with a low platelet count.
commonCauses: Natural variation and differences between analysers
Low platelet production by the bone marrow
